THE BUG (found by stage-by-stage eigvalsh-vs-A, NOT the coordinator's batch-dependence hypothesis -- it was MATRIX-CONTENT-dependent: seed4327 benign, seed75342 exposed it; single-stage was always accurate because it never builds a band):
- PRIMARY (dense->band): _bt_dense_to_band annihilated the panel by zeroing only the LOWER column block A[p+nb:, p:p+nb] and placing R; it left the UPPER row block A[p:p+nb, p+nb:] with its pre-existing BEYOND-BAND dense entries. The final 0.5*(A+A^T) then set those to HALF (not zero), so the 'banded' matrix was NOT a similarity of A -> ~7% eigenvalue error -> eig_scaled ~3000-7000. FIX: zero BOTH the lower column block AND the upper row block before placing R/R^T. Verified: dense->band eigenvalue error 0.07 -> 0.0001, final eig_scaled ~3000 -> ~4 (accurate, 39/39). The qr_panel kernel and TF32 precision were both FINE (the bug was structural, reproduced with torch.geqrf + FP32).
- SECONDARY (band-aware latrd_band): the matvec inner q-loop used q0=i-qwin, which for far output rows i cut off v's head [col+1, i-qwin), dropping matvec terms. FIX: q in [col, col+qwin] for ALL rows (v[q]==0 outside its support, so a support-covering range is exact). Also made reflector/corrections full-range (only the matvec windowed), small b2t panel=8, hiw covering W's full support.
